The pivot lands on ready soil because extensibility is the connective tissue of this whole cycle: **Teknium** publicly [invited builders to package their work as **Hermes plugins**](/?date=2026-10-20&category=social#item-0bc42f4367e7), confirmed existing [**ComfyUI** connector support](/?date=2026-10-20&category=social#item-e03cc7597aa9) for image-generation workflows, and called the [**Unreal Engine MCP** unwieldy at ~**800 tools**](/?date=2026-10-20&category=social#item-38c40f4a3869), while the **Hermes Atlas** skills registry gained the [**kisscode-agent** skill](/?date=2026-10-20&category=news#item-fb70e22ac244) with Hermes-specific install steps — flanked by third-party **GEO** coverage (a [**GEO MCP** server roundup](/?date=2026-10-20&category=news#item-65555ed53675) and a free [**DeepSeek** + **Search Console** workflow guide](/?date=2026-10-20&category=news#item-2f3816905807)). The strongest shipped artifacts are community-built: **@rlaope**'s [**Oh My Hermes 4.0.0 (Zeus)**](/?date=2026-10-20&category=social#item-5f8d061b28f5) — a genuine major release after cycles of "in preparation" coverage, adding a dedicated terminal, long-term memory, specialist workflows and subagent model routing, with an [approving nod from **Teknium**](/?date=2026-10-20&category=social#item-d360217b8a75) — and the news top story, a hands-on [**batch_runner.py** tutorial](/?date=2026-10-20&category=news#item-18edc8956b23) converting **JSONL** prompt files into **ShareGPT**-format trajectories for generating training data and eval sets at scale, with **rlaope** also teasing a [**200B-token** training push](/?date=2026-10-20&category=social#item-b12464aa3683) and sharing a [**Delta Rune** fan-game anecdote](/?date=2026-10-20&category=social#item-4a8876b23414) as proof of real creative agent use. Multi-model orchestration recurs everywhere — the [**Hermes Agent × REA** reverse-engineering demo](/?date=2026-10-20&category=social#item-11ba4af8c351) (binary inspection, call-graph tracing), the [**Codex**↔**Claude Code** issue-to-PR skill](/?date=2026-10-20&category=research#item-hn-49136162), the carried [**Bifrost** router debate](/?date=2026-10-20&category=research#item-hn-49159529) — while the [**Claude Pro/Max** subscription support](/?date=2026-10-20&category=research#item-hn-49790991) and [**Hermes Kanban** multi-agent collaboration](/?date=2026-10-20&category=research#item-hn-49604068) items are once again the carried [**v0.20.0** docs bundle](/?date=2026-10-20&category=research#item-hn-49159200): reference, not news. Security and reliability keep their watch-list pulse: the research top story is a [**Show HN Grafana** observability integration for Hermes Agent](/?date=2026-10-20&category=research#item-hn-49318128) (joining the carried **Grafana** stack), an [Ask HN thread reports a freshly provisioned agent spiraling into a trance-like state](/?date=2026-10-20&category=research#item-hn-49916751), the carried [adversarial LLM-reversal repository](/?date=2026-10-20&category=research#item-hn-49231797) still probes hermes-agent, and — new and cautionary — a [referenced community repo was removed after its owner was hacked, with **@sidbing** floated as a replacement](/?date=2026-10-20&category=social#item-3e57cecd3422): a concrete reminder to vet plugins and skills before installing them. Verification note, now familiar: the reliability thread cites a **GLM 5.3 Flash** backend that does not appear in **Z.ai**'s release record (latest documented: **GLM-5.2**) — treat that model name as unconfirmed. Research pairs unusually well with the ecosystem this cycle: [**MemPilot**](/?date=2026-10-20&category=research#item-2610.06830) (on-demand multimodal memory curation for long-running agents), [**RSIFlow**](/?date=2026-10-20&category=research#item-2610.21791) (adaptive self-improvement with an evolving meta-agent — effectively the academic mirror of the community [**Refine Cycle** plugin](/?date=2026-10-20&category=research#item-hn-49606988); read them together), and [**OpenVLHarness**](/?date=2026-10-20&category=research#item-2610.26860) (real-world visual agentic tool-use with multimodal memory across **22 benchmarks**). Housekeeping: repo movement was the [automated daily sync](/?date=2026-10-20&category=news#item-0c136c05af67) only — no releases and no merged PRs this cycle, so **v0.22.2** remains the build to run (the research feed's "v0.20.0 latest release" line is the stale docs bundle again), the [~**23,000** open-PR backlog](/?date=2026-10-20&category=research#item-hn-49424643) persists as the project-health number, deployment docs matured on the carried [**Kubernetes**](/?date=2026-10-20&category=research#item-hn-49977400)/[containerization](/?date=2026-10-20&category=research#item-hn-50131496) fronts, and Reddit contributed nothing again; the **DeepSeek 4.1 Flash** 90%-off promo chatter (claimed 848 TPS) is third-party, off-topic noise around an existing release (GA 2026-09-10). Net read: the game-dev pivot turned the plugin thesis into a product vision, and the ecosystem answered with real ships — a major **OMH** release, a training-data pipeline tutorial, and a growing skills registry.
